free_tier.stated: 5 GB storage on Free (unlimited on Twist Unlimited); 100 MB per attachment

egress.terms: Free; files served from Twist's own storage

tooling: Twist has an API but no documented bulk file-upload surface and no rclone backend; wrapper-only
chaining: 5 GB x N free teams. Twist free teams are unlimited in number from one account ('create a separate, free team'), so it chains - but 5 GB/team means ~100 teams for 500 GB.
limits_note: 5 GB per team; 100 MB per attachment; 10 MB for emailed attachments; thread history older than one month is not viewable on Free (data retained server-side, not deleted)
reliability_note: Distinctive upside: Twist explicitly never deletes data on the Free plan - the one-month limit is visibility only. That makes it a rare non-hostile free tier, just a small one.

evidence.proved: 'There is a 100MB file size limit for attachments'; 'When using the Free plan of Twist, the storage limit is 5GB'
